right.raw_text: Healthy status is defined by absence of evidence of any active or chronic disease following a detailed medical and surgical history, a complete physical examination including vital signs, 12-lead ECG, hematology, blood chemistry, serology and urinalysis

Male subjects (whether surgically sterilized or not) with female partners of child-bearing potential must use two forms of contraception, one of which must be a barrier method, for the duration of the study and for 77 days after the last dose
